carrier.description: The carrier that collected the waste.

collectionDateTime.description: The actual time the waste was collected, as an ISO 8601 date-time. The planned time was given when the Movement was created.

collectionSite.description: The place the waste was collected from.

brokerOrDealer.description: Any broker or dealer involved in the Collection.

isDutyOfCareConfirmed.description: Carrier confirms they have inspected the waste, that it is as described, and that they are content to transport it.

supportingReferences.description: References that help identify the Collection, such as a PO or job number.

specialHandlingRequirements.description: Handling instructions for the waste. Leave out when there are none.
